name: jumpserver-mcp
description: JumpServer (KoKo) bastion connector for WorkBuddy as an MCP stdio server: persistent SSH/PTY session with explicit state machine, asset discovery via KoKo menu, permission-gated audited commands, target-affinity batch execution, embedded local ops console (live terminal mirror, audit log with JSONL/CSV export, stats, session control). Ported from dsh-jumpserver (core modules reused verbatim).
